crossRefs.note: and go out to the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the gate Harsith, and proclaim there the words…
Say, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says…
Yahweh said this to me: “Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, through which the kings of Judah come…
“Yahweh says: ‘Stand in the court of Yahweh’s house, and speak to all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in…
Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem, in Yahweh’s house, before the new court;
The Spirit of God came on Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest; and he stood above the people, and said to them…
They conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of Yahweh’s house.
Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is…
All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.
“Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

people.name: Topheth
people.line: Site of pagan child sacrifice, south of Jerusalem

translations.web: Then Jeremiah came from Topheth, where Yahweh had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the court of Yahweh’s house, and said to all the people:
